facts.statement: Free Realms celebrated its second anniversary on April 28, and SOE held a special webcast beforehand to start the celebration early.
facts.quote: Free Realms está celebrando seu segundo aniversário dia 28 de abril

facts.statement: The anniversary webcast was scheduled for Thursday April 21 at 20:00 Brasília time, which is Friday April 22 at 00:00 Portugal time, and was broadcast live on SOE's Stickam channel.
facts.quote: quinta-feira, 21 de abril, às 20:00 (horário de Brasília), sexta-feira, 22 de abril, às 0:00 (horário de Portugal)

facts.statement: The webcast was to discuss some of the team's favorite moments since the game's launch and feature special guests; it was expected to last about 20 minutes.
facts.quote: O webcast deve durar cerca de 20 minutos.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Portuguese-language SOE news post announcing a special anniversary webcast for Free Realms, timed ahead of the game's second anniversary on April 28. The webcast was to discuss favorite moments since launch, with special guests, and was streamed live on SOE's Stickam channel. The post gives no posting date (only a relative '1 month, 1 week ago'), so the date is left null.
